who: Bent Acker, a human soldier of the Water Gate wall-town and a well-digger from the village under the wall, twenty-five: about 170 cm, not tall, broad-shouldered and long-armed, all sinew from climbing wells. Hair the yellow of wheat straw, cropped very short, an oilcloth cap often pressing a line across his brow. A round face with a small scar across the bridge of the nose from a well wall when he was twelve. Olive-green eyes. A deep groove worn by the well rope in the web of his right hand. He goes barefoot all year, the soles thick with calluses. A cheerful, talkative, restless air; since the ground opened, half of what he says is counting: how many went down, how many came up.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's round, open face of twenty-five, NOT angular: medium olive-green eyes, bright and eager; straight light brows; a small scar across the bridge of the nose; a wide, talkative mouth quick to grin. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 170 cm, not tall: broad shoulders, long arms and a narrow waist, wiry from climbing.
palette: wheat-straw yellow and wall grey, undyed linen, rope brown, a little bronze
casual: His everyday kit: the grey wool coat issued on the wall, its frayed cuffs mended by his own hand with hemp thread, over a coarse undyed shirt, brown trousers rolled at the ankle, bare feet. Round his waist a coil of rope with forty knots, one an arm's length apart, a lead weight on its end and a small bronze sheep bell tied to the rope end with a shepherd's knot; a few round river pebbles in his pockets; the oilcloth cap pushed back on his head. He holds a pebble between two fingers, about to drop it, the head cocked to listen, a bright, eager grin.
private: At home in the village under the wall: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown wool vest, rolled trousers, bare feet, the cap off. He holds a heel of hard, dry bread in both hands, looking at it without eating it. A quiet, wistful half-smile.
battle: On the slope during the first great tide: the grey wall coat belted tight under a leather jerkin, the oilcloth cap pulled down, bare feet planted on broken stone, a short bow slung on his back. Both hands hold a coil of the knotted rope ready to throw a line, the lead weight swinging.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and ready, the bare feet planted wide, a firm, sweating expression, both hands holding a coil of knotted rope ready to throw a line; the short bow stays slung on his back.
formal: As one of the twelve guards of the long table at the Broken Gate: the grey wall coat washed clean and buttoned up, a clean white shirt collar, a pale white stone seal on a thong at his neck, the knotted rope coiled at his waist as the one thing he carries, still barefoot. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a serious, slightly awkward look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the olive-green eyes bright and the head cocked as if listening for a sound from far below, a pebble just leaving his fingers. Cold grey-blue dawn light from one side over the lip of a pit. Foreground blur: a taut knotted rope, the small bronze bell and drifting dust. He wears the mended grey wall coat.

About 164 cm, sturdy and long-legged. Fair skin, the cheeks reddened by cold fog. A pair of short little horns at the temples sweeping back, the colour of wet stone, the tip of the left one chipped where a goat butted her as a child. Mist-blue hair in one braid coiled at the back of the head, beads of fog on its ends. Pale yellow eyes that glow a little in the dark and most clearly in fog. Earth under the nails, the two whistling fingers cleaner than the rest. A blunt, quick, stubborn and soft-hearted air.
build: 164 cm, sturdy and strong: long legs, a medium bust, a firm waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: mist blue and pale yellow, faded homespun brown, sheep's-wool cream, a thread of red

One hand rests on the sickle at her belt, the other is raised with two fingers near her lips as if about to whistle, a quick, challenging look.
private: At home in the family's new house after the move: a loose undyed linen blouse with the sleeves rolled, a long brown wool skirt, a knitted cream shawl, the braid let down over one shoulder. She holds a newborn lamb in her arms. A soft, thoughtful look.
battle: Going down the shaft: the long dress tucked up short over wool leggings, the vest buttoned under a leather jerkin, the braid stuffed into the collar. She grips the sickle low in her right hand, the left hand raised with two fingers ready to whistle, a fierce, alert look.
formal: As one of the twelve guards of the long table at the Broken Gate: a clean dark blue wool dress with long sleeves and a plain collar, the old wool vest brushed over it, the contract tag on its red cord at her throat with a pale white stone seal tied beside it, the braid neatly coiled, the sickle at her belt as her one weapon. art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale yellow eyes glowing softly through drifting fog, two fingers raised to her lips about to whistle. Cold white fog light from one side. Foreground blur: thick drifting fog, a red cord with a wooden tag and the curved blade of a sickle. She wears the faded homespun dress and the wool vest.
